angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 967,719 km at 584.53 pc = 0.02 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 1.7108 +/- 0.0102 mas (same row, RUWE 0.96): 584.53 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.391 +/- 0.017 solar radii from Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-6 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract): 967,719 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.209 +/- 0.044 solar masses from Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-6 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5647 +/- 44 K from Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-6 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-6 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kepler-6.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.234, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, Kepler-6: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-6 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.34 dex, from Esteves et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-6 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.18916, from Gajdoš et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019RAA....19...41G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-6 (pscomppars): age 3.8 Gyr, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-6 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3 km/s, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
